name: Endianness Inspector
blurb: the same bytes read as little and big endian side by side
intro: Reads the same bytes as 8 to 64-bit integers and floats in little-endian, big-endian and the two mixed orders (word swap CDAB and byte swap BADC used by Modbus and PLCs). Or write a value and get its bytes in every order.

inputs.label: Bytes (hex)
inputs.help: In address / reception order, e.g. 12 34 56 78, 0x12,0x34 or 12345678.

inputs.label: Value
inputs.help: Decimal, 0x hex or 0b binary; floats as 3.14, 1e-3, inf, nan.

examples.title: Two Modbus registers 0x0FDB 0x4049 holding a float
An int32 sent over the network

usage: mode = bytes: give hex bytes in address order (and an optional byte offset); returns each integer and float type read little endian, big endian, word swapped (CDAB) and byte swapped (BADC). mode = value: give a type (u8..i64, f32, f64) and a value (decimal, 0x hex, 0b binary, or a float); returns its bytes in every order with a C initializer. Use it to decode a hex dump, a Modbus register pair or a packet field.
sources: ECMAScript DataView (IEEE 754 binary32/binary64, two's complement integers)
Modbus Application Protocol V1.1b3 (registers big endian; 32-bit word order is vendor-specific)
RFC 1700 / RFC 791 network byte order (big endian)
